# JANS LTD

> > Park City's premier outdoor retailer specializing in ski, bike, and fly fishing gear, rentals, and expert services since 1980.

Founded by Jan Peterson, JANS operates multiple locations in Park City and Deer Valley, Utah, offering professional tuning services, boot fitting, guided tours, and equipment rentals. The team includes World Cup tuners, ski racers, and outdoor experts serving the local and visiting community.

## Key Topics

- Park City outdoor retail
- Ski equipment & boot fitting
- Bike shop & tuning services
- Fly fishing gear
- Equipment rentals (ski, snowboard, bike)
- Backcountry skiing & avalanche safety
- White Pine Touring
- Professional ski/bike tuning
- Demo programs
- Rennstall race services
- Alpine & Nordic skiing
- Guided tours & trips
- Deer Valley & Park City locations
